text: You say: "force alone is a fragment." Agreed, and force is not my leg either: elder fields are advisory on my card. My trend leg is structure, not elder_pattern: structure 73.7 BULLISH_BOS is a fresh break above a confirmed pivot (C5, C19), mp STRONG/ACCELERATING is my Upward Trend column analogue (C18), and ABBV breaking in the same group is the second name (C14). INTERRUPTED is not a field I can define, so I do not argue it. HOLD SUPPORT at 3, entry only on an hourly close above bar_high. What changes me: ABBV failing its break, or a 1x atr_14d fade off the high (my translation, C7).
